description.narrative: The Projet Wér-Gu-Yaram: Renforcement des ASC et Foires Sanitaires pour les Femmes et les Enfants in Senegal, implemented by Foundation for a Healthier Senegal (FOHSEN), aims to improve maternal and child health in underserved communities of Senegal by strengthening the role and capacity of community health workers (both youth volunteers and Badienou Gokh) and ensuring better access to quality, culturally relevant healthcare services. The objectives of the grant are to Train 12 community health workers (youth and Badienou Gokh) in maternal, neonatal, and child health to deliver effective, community-based healthcare, Equip the trained health workers with digital tools to enhance case management, follow-up, and data reporting., Organize two community health fairs to provide free consultations, awareness sessions, and distribution of essential medicines and baby products, and Foster collaboration between communities, local health structures, and FOHSEN to ensure sustainability of the interventions.
